examples.title: Nytra Core Essentials
examples.description: Explore a playable Blueprint training room. Route power to a gate and operate a cargo lift using variables, Set Parameter, branches, signals, property bindings, and reusable tasks. Includes save/load with resume and snap restoration.
examples.releaseNotes: Initial release: Power Routing and Cargo Lift stations, Blueprint interaction, and save/load demonstrating resume and snap restoration. Save with 5; load with 9.
